Tier 3 must-haves: STC with biometric + dark fiber + redstone, constant-climate feel, surface plateau with visitor center
55M at marquee / 14M in leasing office / 16 ft ceiling / 150 ft depth / 55+ tenants / 1964 / 68 F / 8.2 mi road
4 fit-out archetypes: records archive, package logistics, data center, general industrial

Public shaft ~5x5, Public Access Lobby with guard booth and turnstile, [X] project fiction
No Indiana Jones / Batcave / Bond contamination, no torches/lava/mob_spawners in developed zones, no fantasy contamination
